MECHANISM: Cross-head twenty-third-distance bias tying

HYPOTHESIS: Sharing the twenty-third-farthest relative-attention bias across both heads will reduce the model from 606 to 605 learned parameters while retaining at least 99% accuracy.

INTENDED_EDIT: Shorten the head-specific relative-bias core by one distance and reconstruct the removed distance with one shared learned scalar.

EVIDENCE: The 606-parameter model achieved 99.89% accuracy, and sharing each of the nine adjacent farther-distance biases through the twenty-second-farthest distance retained at least 99%; prior attempts at this boundary produced no verification result and therefore provide no contrary accuracy evidence.
